title: WinVest Acquisition Corp. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-15
summary: WinVest Acquisition Corp., an OTC Markets-listed SPAC, filed an 8-K disclosing a $30,000 drawdown under an existing $180,000 unsecured promissory note with its Sponsor, WinVest SPAC LLC. The drawdown extends the SPAC's deadline to consummate a business combination from April 17, 2026 to May 17, 2026.
key_points: WinVest issued an unsecured promissory note for up to $180,000 to Sponsor WinVest SPAC LLC on March 16, 2026
The second drawdown of $30,000 occurred on April 10, 2026, extending the Termination Date to May 17, 2026
The Promissory Note does not bear interest and matures upon Business Combination closing or Company liquidation
Drawdowns are structured in six equal amounts of $30,000 each
If no Business Combination is consummated, the note is repaid only from funds outside the Trust Account
The deposited funds will be distributed to Public Share holders upon liquidation or redemption
Company is listed on OTC Markets (WINV, WINVU, WINVW, WINVR) and is an emerging growth company
